about: Renders a run of text inside a line. A span has no semantics and inherits the font of its line.

motion.about: The animation a span enters with. Each one runs once when the span mounts.
motion.title: Motion

title: Span

tone.about: Every text ink at every weight, inside a line of body text. The inverted ink is for a dark surface, so its row renders on `bg.inverted`.
tone.title: Inks and weights

truncate.about: A log path that wraps in a 320px room, and the same path cut to one line with an ellipsis.
truncate.title: Truncate
